simple.meaning: שִׁמְרוֹן (Shimrôwn) appears 5 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a son in the family line and in connection with kingship.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Genesis, Numbers, Joshua, 1 Chronicles, beginning at Genesis 46:13. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family line, kingship.

definitions.full: H8110. Shimrown I. שִׁמְרוֺן proper name, of a location Canaanite city , with king: Josh 11:1 , in Zebulun 19:15 , Συμοων , Σομερων , etc., = ׳שׁ מְראוֺן 12:20 . II. שִׁמְרוֺן proper name, masculine son of Issachar , Gen 46:13 ; Numbers 24:64; 1Chr 7:1 ; Ζαμβραμ , Σαμβρα , Σεμερων , etc.
